items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: We used to fight each other across the street from each other.

ctx.x: Where did you used to see him really? Did you see him around town?

I seen him around town, around Canary, around Ramport. I seen him around Canary and Ramport and I was talking to him then. How long ago? About a year or something ago. Maybe a little more. Because we was talking on the same thing all about these days. And he was glad after he found out who I was he started repulsing all of them. We used to fight each other across the street from each other.
Well see I wish we could get his last name. He might be a good guy to find.
